pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions display complex polygonal geometry with a mix of acute and obtuse vertices. Pixel gradients along the edges are predominantly sharp, though some regions show softening due to fur texture. Patch area is maximal on the mid-flank and decreases significantly towards the posterior and limb regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light pelage forms a continuous topological lattice. Junction nodes primarily consist of tri-radiate and quadri-radiate intersections. The pixel thickness of these corridors is non-uniform, appearing narrower between large central patches and widening as the network approaches the ventral and posterior margins.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The 1D silhouette of the mane along the upper neck and shoulder exhibits a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged profile with dense, fine-grained peaks against the out-of-focus background.
